content.what_it_is: MIXING_STUFF gates mean-property processing until TIME reaches STEADY_TIME (L64-L89). CALCULATE_MEAN accumulates time-weighted velocity, elevation, depth-averaged flow, discharge, second moments, friction and breaking terms; when T_sum reaches T_INTV_mean it computes means, radiation-stress/pressure/flux derivatives, significant and zero-upcrossing wave-height products, emits PREVIEW_MEAN, resets interval sums and retains overshoot time (L119-L316).
unresolved: When a step crosses T_INTV_mean, the full current DT is added to all sums at L154-L178 and used in the completed mean, but L235 retains T_sum-T_INTV_mean while L236-L253 reset every sum to zero. The retained fractional time has no corresponding retained integral, so the next interval's denominator includes unrepresented time and biases all means low after non-exact interval crossings.

ETA2sum at L157/L278 measures deviations from ETAmean, but ETAmean is updated only at interval completion L165 and then held through the next interval. UUsum/UVsum/VVsum at L171-L173 and L285-L287 similarly use prior-window U_davg_mean/V_davg_mean and ETAmean. The reported ETA2mean and radiation moments are therefore centered on the previous interval's means, not the same samples' means; no correction term is applied when the mean changes.

Wave extrema/upcrossing detection exists only in the T_sum<T_INTV_mean ELSE branch L294-L312. The sample that reaches/crosses the interval threshold follows the IF branch and contributes to time sums L157-L178 but is skipped by Emax/Emin and zero-upcrossing logic, dropping one wave-detection sample at every mean-output boundary.

Num_Zero_Up, HavgSum and HrmsSum resets are commented out at L264-L266 while interval sums reset at L235-L253. Consequently WaveHeightAve/RMS at L261-L262 are cumulative across all prior waves, whereas SigWaveHeight and the mean/radiation fields are interval products; whether that mixed temporal basis is intended is not established in the routine.
